title: Denise's Turkey Burgers
description: Simple pan-fried turkey burgers with bread crumbs and egg, finished with melted cheese. Makes 3 full patties plus 2 small ones.

portion.size: 1 full patty (1/4 of the batch, about 110g cooked) with 1 slice of cheese, or 2 small patties

instructions: In a bowl, mix 450g ground turkey, 1/2 cup bread crumbs, 1/4 tsp salt, pepper, and 1 egg until combined.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal patties.
Take one patty and split it into two smaller patties (you'll have 3 full patties and 2 small ones).
Heat a pan over medium heat and pan fry the patties for 5 minutes.
Top each patty with cheese, cover the pan, and cook until the cheese melts and the burgers reach 165°F inside (1–2 minutes).
notes: Macros are estimated per full patty using 93% lean ground turkey and one slice of cheddar; the two small patties together equal one serving. Bun and toppings are not included.
